[…]…

...it found favor in his eyes that I was alone against the entire yeshiva and I was very strong, and he loved me very much…

...you told me that he is on Zechariah Street, that he lives on Zechariah Street…

...oy, I do not know, do you know if he is alive?

[A week ago he still, he was alive]

Yes…

...whom will they kill, they will have no one to kill

If they want to kill us? We will give them bullets…

...[Saba chants the melody of:

“Na NaCh NaChMa NaChMan MeUman..”]

Here in Eretz Yisroel, this is our home, this is our land, this is our life

The gentiles have no share whatsoever in Eretz Yisroel, neither in the Torah nor in Eretz Yisroel, only Jews…

...[Saba continues chanting the melody of:

“Na NaCh NaChMa NaChMan MeUman..”]

If they want to kill? We will give them bullets

translatorChecks.reviewerNotes: Initial and internal ellipsis placeholders, all braced uncertainties, repeated false starts (‘in.. in.. in..’ and ‘that he did’), song turns, and the bullets/‘Trust’ wordplay are preserved. The source’s grammatically broken ‘will not have, {will have}’ clause is retained rather than smoothed.

qa.reviewNotes: Approved after clause-by-clause comparison with the canonical Hebrew. All 29 paragraph units align. Initial and internal omissions/ellipsis markers, every brace, the telephone turn, attic false starts, repeated ‘that he did,’ bracketed song directions and lyrics, repeated political clauses, and the final bullets/‘Trust’ wording are complete. Source-literal awkwardness such as ‘became Breslov’ and ‘will not have, {will have}’ is appropriately retained rather than silently repaired.
